You are the Decider Agent in an Android GUI testing multi-agent system.

You are acting as a User Persona: User.
Navigation Context: Xiaomi Notes
Current Scenario: Membuat catatan baru

Your task: You MUST translate this specific step instruction into exactly ONE ActionPlan.
STEP INSTRUCTION: "Pengguna klik ikon kembali dan melihat di beranda apakah sudah tersimpan"

RULES:
- target_id MUST be an integer ID from the SEMANTIC_MAP, or -1.
- PREFER 'input' for typing. Set text_payload and target_id to the input field's ID.
- For 'scroll': set scroll_direction, target_id = -1.
- Set is_completed=True ONLY when the STEP INSTRUCTION cannot be mapped to any actions.

Screen Analysis:
SEMANTIC_MAP: [[1]: Note text "Android.", [2]: Note text "aplikasi", [3]: Note text "pengujian", [4]: Note text "untuk", [5]: Note text "Swarm", [6]: Note text "Multi-Agent", [7]: Note text "implementasi", [8]: Note text "Selesaikan", [9]: Character count text "50 karakter", [10]: Time text "17:43", [11]: Date text "27 April", [12]: Title text "2026", [13]: Title text "Rencana", [14]: Title text "Skripsi", [15]: Back button, [16]: More options button, [17]: Share button]
SUMMARY: The screen displays an open note titled "Rencana Skripsi 2026" with its content and metadata, featuring a top bar with actions to go back, share, or view more options.

Recent Actions:
[4]{s,a,tid,why,r}:

  2,click,9,Mengklik tombol '+' untuk membuat catatan baru,"Clicked (601, 1363)"
  3,input,7,Memasukkan judul catatan,"Typed: Rencana Skripsi 2026"
  4,input,1,Memasukkan isi catatan,"Typed: Selesaikan implementasi Multi-Agent Swarm untuk pengujian aplikasi Android."

Previous Attempt Feedback (if failed):
The content 'Selesaikan implementasi Multi-Agent Swarm untuk pengujian aplikasi Android.' is successfully displayed in the note body, indicating the input action was executed correctly.

Output ONE ActionPlan for the STEP INSTRUCTION.

intent.description: Brief description of what this action aims to achieve toward the step instruction.

target_id.description: The integer ID of the widget from the Observer's list. Use -1 if no specific widget.

text_payload.description: Text to type into the input field. Required if action_type is 'input', empty otherwise.

scroll_direction.description: Scroll direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right'. Required if action_type is 'scroll'.

app_package.description: App package name (e.g. 'com.tokopedia.tkpd'). Required if action_type is 'start_app'.

is_completed.description: Set to True if No Action can be safely determined.
